    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Axis
    Enumeration representing the different XPath axes supported by the XPathCommand.
    ChildCommand
    Command to retrieve and print the nth child element of a specified XML element.
    ChildrenCommand
    Command to list all children of a specified XML element, printing each child's tag name along with its attributes.
    CloseCommand
    Command that closes the currently loaded XML document.
    Command
    Represents a command that can be executed within the XML parser application.
    CommandHandler
    Handles user commands for the XML parser application.
    CommandName
    Enum representing the supported command names in the XML parser.
    CommandParser
    Parses user input into command names and arguments.
    CommandParser.ParsedCommand
    Represents a parsed command, containing the command name and its arguments.
    DeleteCommand
    Command to delete an attribute from a specified XML element.
    ExitCommand
    Command that terminates the application.
    HelpCommand
    Command that displays a list of all available commands and their usage.
    NewchildCommand
    Command to add a new child element with a unique auto-generated ID to the specified parent element in the XML document.
    OpenCommand
    Command to open and load an XML file into the XMLDocument.
    PrintCommand
    Command to print the current XML document's root element and its contents in a formatted, human-readable way.
    SaveAsCommand
    Command to save the current XML document to a specified file path.
    SaveCommand
    Command to save the currently opened XML document to its existing file path.
    SelectCommand
    Command to select and display the value of a specific attribute from an XML element identified by its id.
    SetCommand
    Command to set or update an attribute of a specific XML element.
    TextCommand
    Command to print the text content of a specified XML element.
    XMLDocument
    The XMLDocument class represents an entire XML document, providing methods for managing the document structure, including loading from and saving to files, indexing elements by their IDs, and accessing individual elements by ID.
    XMLElement
    Represents a single XML element within an XML document.
    XMLParserApplication
    The main entry point for the XML parser application.
    XPathCommand
    Command that evaluates a simplified XPath expression starting from a specified element.
